description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git rebase' with the --fork-point option. It sets up a git repository, defines test cases, and runs various rebase scenarios to verify correct functionality.

methods.name: do_test_rebase
methods.description: Performs a rebase operation on the specified branch and compares the results against the expected output.

methods.name: test_rebase
methods.description: Runs a rebase test case with a specified expected commit sequence.
